text: 上海市房地产交易中心官网“网上房地产”数据显示，10月上海二手房（含商业）累计网签24653套，不仅超越“金九”约2.35万套的成交规模，同比更是大幅上涨33%，创下近六年同期成交新高。“目前多重因素共同托举市场预期。”在上海中原地产市场分析师卢文曦看来，随着政策持续落地，楼市逐步企稳，购房者心态也随之转变。此前不少潜在买家因担忧房价继续下行，选择暂缓入场；而随着上海二手住宅价格连续多月环比上涨，市场止跌回暖的信号已经明确。（澎湃新闻）
text_en: Data from the official "Online Real Estate" website of the Shanghai Real Estate Trading Center shows that in October, Shanghai's second-hand homes (including commercial) recorded a cumulative 24,653 online-signed transactions, not only surpassing the roughly 23,500 transactions in "Golden September" but also jumping 33% YoY, hitting a new high for the same period in nearly six years. "Multiple factors are currently jointly propping up market expectations," said Lu Wenxi, a market analyst at Shanghai Centaline Property. In his view, as policies continue to be implemented and the housing market gradually stabilizes, homebuyer sentiment has also shifted. Previously, many potential buyers chose to stay on the sidelines out of worry that home prices would keep falling; now, with Shanghai second-hand residential prices rising MoM for several consecutive months, the signal that the market has halted its decline and is recovering is clear. (The Paper)
